supportedPlatform: arm64-apple-darwin25.5.0 with APFS and macOS SDK 26.5
transaction: One helper process owns parent, ancestor, root, and working directory descriptors from exclusive root creation through seal or fail-closed exit.
inputProtocol: ASCII command headers: FILE <lowercase-hex-path> <decimal-size> <lowercase-sha256>, followed by exactly size raw bytes and one newline; final SEAL newline.
outputProtocol: One strict JSON success receipt on stdout; one stable M9B13D_ERROR code on stderr and nonzero exit on failure.
failurePolicy: Partial, foreign, ambiguous, collided, or interrupted state is retained for inspection and never automatically deleted or reused.
syntheticFaults: Explicit fault injection is accepted only in synthetic mode and is rejected in prospective mode.
